commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Changed How data cross references work. Any piece of data that needs to reference another piece of data should use the DataReference<T> type. In xml this is expressed in the following way: <ParentBody Ref="Sol" />. These References are now resolved at load previously there were a variety of adhoc approaches, most which involved some form of Get() command which ran a dictionary lookup.

Changed How subpart data cross-references other subpart data. You now use the KeyReference<T> where T implements IKeyed. For example the Rocket Subpart of EngineALargeVacAssembly references its Core and Nozzle this way: <Core KeyRef="ThrustChamber" />. Sub Elements that need to be cross Referenced must implement IKeyed. These are resolved on load. The optional SubPart attribute should be used when the reference crosses to another template type e.g. Solid rocket motors FeedsFrom element.
Changed Any xml lists must use the [XmlArray] flag. This is to support modder's ability to add to or modify xml arrays.

Changed Data merging is now a formalized process. Previously the partGameData would be merged into the auto-generated Part after serialization by Id. Now the two pieces of data exist as a Part element, the autogenerated data loads first. Elements of the same Id will be handled based on the Modify attribute.

Added Elements in the Assets scope may declare a Modify attribute: Patch, Replace or Remove. Patch will merge the data with an existing element of the same id, Replace replaces it and remove deletes the element of that id.

Changed any type that inherits from SerializedId MUST be declared as a child element of <Assets> and have a unique Id. Any child elements of a SerializedID that need to be referenced should use IKeyed and declare a Key attribute.

Child Xml elements can also use the Modify Attribute to change how their parent modifies the Patched data. The default behaviour is to replace, the extend action will add this childs elements to the matching element in the patched data.
Added ContentSerializer Cache. This creates and caches an XmlSerializer per type, otherwise a new Serializer would need to be created for each row which is much slower.
Changed A broad standardization pass on xml data, stricter usage of the attribute Id, name, key and ref. Each now have their own meaning enforced.
Added a comprehensive test suite for Data loading. The new rules are tested and strictly enforced.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed Connect only creating one fuel port and one fuel line when a port with symmetry was linked to a part with no port. The new port now gets a copy on every part in the clicked part's symmetry set, or around the clicked part when it has no symmetry, and each copy is linked.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed tank auto-fill in the vehicle editor only following fuel lines into a tank. A tank with a fuel line leading out now also fills with what the tank at the other end holds or feeds to its engines.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added Air and Supplies tank role affinities. Air and Supplies each need a tank of their own, while Engine and Thruster can still share one.
Supply tanks show "Supply Use" instead of "Propellant Use".
Tanks assigned Air or Supplies affinities are auto-filled with life support resources.
Fixed tanks with no saved contents staying empty after loading, and fixed a part placed as a new vessel's first part not filling its tanks.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW

Fixed atmosphere scattering coefficients being overwritten on load; the authored per-kilometre values are now kept as written.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz

Fixed the vehicle editor merging different tanks on one part into one set of controls once they were configured alike. Only tanks of the same size share controls now, and each set is labelled with its tank names and volume.

commits.author: GitHub
lines: Added undo and redo to the Vehicle Editor (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z, or the UNDO and REDO buttons).
Added an on-screen message that shows what was undone or redone.
Added an Undo History Debug window to the Vehicle Editor's Debug menu.
Fixed thermal and antimatter engines losing their fuel flow rule on save and load.
Fixed an invalid spawn bounding box for vehicles with no geometry.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Added aerodynamic mesh generation. This is the first step in an improved aerodynamic simulation, for for the moment it doesn't affect the game. Every complete vehicle has a new mesh generated from its colliders (for now). Shapes which are far apart are meshed separately, while shapes that are close together or intersecting are remeshed as one watertight body using a voxelization and dual contouring method. The coarseness of the mesh is adjusted to keep the total number of panels below a certain threshold to avoid computational explosions in the future force solver.
Added the ability to draw the aero mesh in game or in the vehicle editor.
Added the ability to draw physics colliders in the vehicle editor.
Added PersistentBatch which allows jobs in a DynamicWorkerPool to span across multiple frames (until awaited).

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Added Lander Can (metal and cloth wrapped variants).
Added Small and Medium Probe cores.
Added Larger size Strut parts.
Added Foil wrapped Strut Variant parts.
Added Truss and trus adapter with cloth wrapped variants.
Added 4 bridging adaptors (with hollow variants)
Updated Existing strut parts to use less subparts.
Added WIP structural panels. Still working out what the best system is for connecting them, currently they have no connection points and are face snap only.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added radiation shielding to the Lander Cans. Their hull now protects a kitten at 1.8 g/cm², about a third of the medium capsule's hull, in line with NASA's figures for the Apollo Lunar Module against the Command Module. There is no liner, so the medium capsule remains the safer place to sit out a solar storm.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed the Gemini7 and Rocket test vehicles saving a seat for a kitten who isn't in the roster. Each vehicle now starts with two kittens from the current game's roster, one in each seat, instead of one real kitten and an empty seat that the game counted as occupied.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Fixed incorrect scales on upper connector or lander cans.
Fixed orientation of Panel thumbnails, they now face the camera.
Added ThumbnailRotation to PartTemplate. Specify a thumbnail rotation offset per part in radians.
Removed flaky test.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Added a blame system for vehicles / bubbles which are throttling the time compression rate to help quickly identify what is causing performance issues, even in released builds. These are displayed as a ranked list of physics tasks that took longer than the allotted budget in the Frame Statistics (F1) overlay.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added life support part module. Kittens breathe oxygen, drink water, eat meals and use CO₂ scrubber canisters.
Oxygen and water come from Air and Water tanks the vessel's plumbing reaches.
Meals and canisters are kept in habitat storage and add to the vessel's mass.
The medium capsule carries three days for two kittens and the Lander Cans three days for one.
A crewed part's window shows its zone's kittens and the time left for each supply, and its habitat's meals and canisters. Running out does not harm kittens, Just Yet! But soon!

Added habitat part module which splits vehicle into zones. Habitats attached to each other or joined through crew passages and open docking port hatches form one zone that shares its meals and canisters. Any other part between them keeps them apart.
Docked ports have Close Hatch and Open Hatch in their part menu and an open hatch closes again when the ports undock.
Added a "Life support low" alert. Time warp drops to 1x when a vessel has a day of supplies left and again at an hour and again when they run out.
Added unit tests for all of the above.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Adds the vehicle, part tree, docking port, physics bubble, alert, part window and content changes that go with the new Habitat and LifeSupport modules, and takes out two references to the Habitat Zones window, which comes in a later commit.

Why it happened: the reflog shows a rebase onto origin/main right after I staged commit 1. Rider shelves uncommitted work before an update and puts it back afterwards, and the put-back unstages modified files. New files stayed staged, so the commit got only the 8 new files, at their full working versions. To avoid a repeat, stage after updating from origin, not before. If you update after staging, let me know and I'll check the index before
y

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added life support readouts. The Resources gauge shows days left for Air, Water, Food and CO₂ scrubbing.
The vehicle editor's sequence footer shows the vessel's life support and who it assumes is aboard.
The Universe Manifest has a Life Support column and the transfer planner warns when the crew's supplies would run out before arrival.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added a Habitat Zones window,in the Editor menu and the flight View menu or with Shift+F6.
It lists each zone's habitable volume per kitten, storage, the meals and canisters stored, crew and how long its supplies last.
Highlight all zones checkbox, or a zone's own Highlight checkbox, tints all teh parts in that zone. Colour represents how many supplies are left in the zone.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added moving between seats. A seated kitten's crew portrait has a SEAT button next to the EVA button and the Habitat Zones window has a Move button beside each seated kitten in flight.
Both move the kitten to any empty seat in its habitat zone including a docked vessel's seats through an open hatch.
While choosing the kitten's seat is marked green with an arrow to the seat under the mouse.
Added unit tests for moving between seats.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added life support failure. A kitten out of oxygen, CO₂ scrubbing, water or food becomes degraded, then incapacitated, then dies.
Oxygen and scrubbing times scale with the habitat zone's volume per kitten.
Each kitten counts down against its own habitat zone's supplies.
A kitten getting worse shows an alert and drops warp to 1x, and a death shows an alert.
Kittens recover once the supply is back.
Added serialization of kitten condition into save games.
Added unit tests for the life support failure ladder.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added life support failure effects. A degraded kitten refuses to EVA and an incapacitated kitten can't move seats. A vessel loses control when every kitten aboard is incapacitated and it has no probe core and disabled controls now say why.
Added unit tests for the EVA and incapacitated checks.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added a Cause of Death column to the Kitten Roster's Memorial tab. Every kitten death records its cause, such as no oxygen, radiation, ground impact or a fall, and saves it with the game.
Added unit tests for causes of death.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added a kitten's life support condition to its crew portrait and to a Condition column in the Kitten Roster, such as "Degraded: no oxygen".
Hovering over it shows how long until the kitten gets worse or recovers after resupply.
Added unit tests for the time to the next rung.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added meal and CO₂ canister sliders to the editor part settings for habitats, so a crewed part can carry less than a full load to save mass.
Added unit tests for habitat loadouts.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Removed the 4 Passage Hatch parts as they are not required for any game-play purpose, the sub parts and mesh atlases remain as they are used by other parts.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Removed CoreCouplingA_Prefab_DockingPort1WA and CoreCouplingA_Prefab_DockingPort1WC. These docking port variant parts were missing a hatch sub part and did not have unique gameplay behaviour, removing them for now to avoid confusion.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed the radiation and condition lines under crew portraits overlapping the next kitten's on smaller screens or larger interface scales. Each line now shrinks to fit under its portrait.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added a Life Support category to the vehicle editor with two supply lockers, SL-M1 and SL-M2, that fit into service module bays. A locker in a service module joins the crew's habitat zone and adds its food and CO₂ canisters to the zone's supplies. They use placeholder models for now.
Added a storage-free habitat to every service module so it joins its crew part's habitat zone and allows kittens to pass through them.
The editor's Habitat Storage sliders and the part window's supply rows now only show on habitats that can store supplies.
Added unit tests for the supply lockers and service module habitat zones.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Updated CoreCommandB Diffuse and PBR textures.

commits.author: Linx-RW
lines: Added terrain blend start/end ranges to ground clutter materials.

commits.author: Linx-RW
lines: Added basic terrain baking functionality. This allows baking out terrain height, normals and curvature. Currently used for ground clutter curvature data.
Added curvature masking to ground clutter. Clutter can choose the frequency to bake curvature for - 1x, 1/2x, 1/4x, 1/8x, relative to the ecotype's object separation.
Increased the density of Mars' rocks.
Biased Mars' rocks to prefer generating in cavities.

commits.author: Linx-RW
lines: Moved terrain baker out of the terrain data and into its own class so it can be reused for both render and collideable clutter generation.

commits.author: Linx-RW
lines: Fixed collideable ground clutter not accounting for terrain curvature when generating.
Gave the ecotype physical data its own terrain data.
Added buffer reallocation/resizing to the ground clutter terrain data so it reallocates along with the ground clutter physical data.

commits.author: lghassen
lines: Fix typo in the multiple scattering approximation for the clouds and plume trails. Part of the calculation was done in a local variable that was never used, this typo resulted in the characteristic "dark edge effect" on the clouds being almost completely absent. This is still an empirical approximation but it looks as intended now.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Added EdgeSnapping Connection system. Panel parts can edge snap to other panel parts. Q and E will rotate the part on the attached pivot and A/D will swap the attched edge.
Changed Moved Panels to their own category

Added Part Variant system. Parts that have cosmetic variants will now be grouped together in the part window. Chevrons on either side of the bvutton switch the variant. A variant can also be changed on a placed part via the right click menu or by pressing V when hovering over a placed part. Pressing V when holding a part will switch its variant if it has them.

Changed GLB to xml utility will now auto create variants when parts are imported if the following is true: If a part name ends with an A suffix the importer will look for a part with the same name and the B/C/D suffix and so on. It will group them as cosmetic variants if the collision and connection data match exactly.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added supply transfer. The Habitat Zones window lists each zone's storage parts with their meals and CO₂ canisters.
In flight a Move button moves supplies to another part in the same zone. A kitten in the zone who isn't incapacitated has to carry them.
If all kittens in the zone are incapacitated the Move buttons are disabled and say why.
Added Supplies and Kittens headings to each zone in the Habitat Zones window and made the window scale with the interface scale so long lines fit.
Hovering a storage part in the Habitat Zones window highlights it on the vessel.
While moving supplies the source and destination parts are highlighted in purple with an arrow between them.
Added unit tests for supply transfer.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Added ColliderRaycast FaceSnapMode. Parts can option into this form of facesnapping via the FaceSnapMode="PhysicsCollider" attribute. Panels and struts and trusses now use this system. This should allow for more easy face-snapping
Removed Part variant tooltip when placing a part with variants.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed the clutter import tool writing the default terrain fade start and end into every imported clutter material, which failed the import tool unit test on the build server.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added unit tests for docking hatches and blocked connectors joining and splitting habitat zones, and for a closed hatch stopping a kitten from moving seats.
Added comments marking the resource manager rebuild as not thread safe, so it stays on the main thread.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Tank transfers now move gasses as well as liquids, so a docked vessel can be resupplied with air.
The tank transfer alerts now say "Tank transfer" instead of "Fuel transfer" since they also cover oxygen and water.
Added unit tests for tank transfers.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Radiation no longer stops time warp for strong flares or for radiation sickness. Time warp now only stops when a kitten is close to a lethal radiation dose (3 Sv) with a warning.
Space weather warnings are now only shown for CMEs aimed at a crewed vessel's location, which cuts the number of warnings.
Added unit tests for the radiation warp stop thresholds and for storms not aimed at the crew not warning.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added 2026 ED138, the dwarf planet candidate found by the Rubin Observatory and announced on 27 October 2026. It orbits the Sun at about 43 AU and is about 970 km across. It starts at its closest point to the Sun, like the other distant dwarf planets.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Space weather warnings are no longer shown for kittens landed or splashed down on a planet with an atmosphere including on the launchpad since the air shields them.
Added a unit test for space weather warnings skipping crews landed under an atmosphere.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Radiation code now reports why a lookup failed (a CME that misses or a target inside the star, no solar wind, an orbit with no field, one that hits the surface or isn't closed) instead of only whether it worked. No change in game.
Unit tests for CMEs, storm passes and orbit dose now check the reason for each result.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Life support and crew code now reports why something was refused when seating or moving kittens, boarding, going on EVA, passing between habitat zones and drawing supplies instead of only whether it worked. No change in game.
Unit tests for crew seating, crew moves, EVA readiness and supply draws now check the reason for each refusal.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed a stray character in last commit causing syntax error.

commits.author: Hanan Finnerty
lines: Fixed casing on some generated .glb files

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added Radiation and Life Support switches to the game startup configuration screen and the Universe > Rules menu.
These two settings are saved with each save game that can later be turned into game settings/difficulty settings.
Turning these off stops Radiation or Life Support from processing only IE: no radiation doses, no supply use, no alerts or time warp stops, and only crew readouts are hidden.
Existing doses and conditions are kept and carry on from where they were if the switch is turned back on.
Older saves load with both of these switches on. These settings are temporary until game types and difficulty settings are added.
Added unit tests for saving the game rules.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Changed Module Template data is now always declared inside the modules scope and now inherits from TemplateDataBase. Perviously there were severl different patterns being used in the project and this seemed the best one to standardize around.

Changed Several Module Templates (DockingPorts, Batteries, MagneticScoops, PowerConsumers, SolarPanels, SolarTrackers, Generators) to be declared inside the Components Collection of PartTemplate, rather than in their own lists.
Changed Decouplers now reference ConnectorIds via a KeyRef.
Added Tests to valid new content authoring rules around KeyRefs for modules that reference other modules.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Re-import of a number of parts to update Id's to reflect the new rules around variant naming. Parts Id's should only have an A-Z suffix if they are part of a variant group. Reimport also fixed some minor collider and connection issues with Structural parts.

commits.author: Linx-RW
lines: Fixed procedural modifiers not applying terrain colour. This brings back the Moon's ejecta craters and brighter slopes.

commits.author: Linx-RW
lines: Fixed ground clutter not accounting for procedural modifier colours when sampling the terrain colour.

commits.author: Linx-RW
lines: Unified the barycentric convention used in the ground clutter generation shaders.

commits.author: Linx-RW
lines: Added a new colour-only modifier that applies a colour in a given latitude/longitude/altitude range.
Modifiers that don't contribute to height are now skipped by the terrain baker.
Fixed procedural modifier LUT sampling being off by half a texel.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed fuel lines not moving any fuel. The fuel port's connector was not letting fuel through into the tank it is mounted on.
Added unit tests for fuel lines between a core and radial boosters.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed engines on radially attached tanks placed with symmetry losing access to their fuel and the stage delta-v dropping when a decoupler was attached below them. Only one booster's engine was being counted.
Added unit tests for decouplers below symmetric engines.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed lights placed in symmetry not switching on and off together. Switching a light now switches its symmetry copies too and can be undone in the editor.
Added unit tests for switching lights in symmetry.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed a GPU crash (device lost) on some AMD GPUs on Linux when zooming the map onto a gas giant. Planets without a height map now use an empty one instead of an invalid texture index.

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Changed Grouped Several Cosmetic variants of decoupler.
Fixed Ids of Bridging adapters as they had the variant suffixes but were not variants.
Fixed Octo strut H was not grouped with its foil variant.

commits.author: CHRocketwerkz
lines: Fixing missing HDR Metadata for scRGB which caused issues on desktop environments which have their own tonemapper for windows

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed a vehicle resting on another (such as a capsule decoupled on the launch pad) being left hanging in mid-air when the craft below it fell away and holding back the craft pushing it. Added unit tests for waking a vehicle off rails.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Fixed the TWR on the engine gauge scaling solid boosters with the throttle, so it read far too low when throttled down with boosters burning. It now shows the thrust the engines are actually producing.

commits.author: aaron.koolen-bourke
lines: Updated the Brutal packages and added references to the new RocketWerkz.Brutal.Collections, Logging, Memory, Numerics and Strings packages.
Updated code to build against the new Brutal collection types, for example by replacing NativeList.Count assignment with Resize.

Fixed native memory leaks now that Brutal collections no longer have finalizers. Owners such as CharacterAvatar, HalfEdgeGraph, the part model pipelines and the main pass now dispose the native collections and vertex inputs they create.
Added unit tests for native list and native collection ownership.
Added an ownership tracking board for the Brutal update.
Added .serena to .gitignore.

commits.author: aaron.koolen-bourke
lines: Fixed RenderTechnique leaking shader stages. It now disposes the previous shader stages when it rebuilds its shaders, and disposes the final shader stages when it is disposed.
Added a unit test for RenderTechnique shader stage disposal.

commits.author: aaron.koolen-bourke

Replaced the source-text RenderTechnique test with behavioral RenderTechnique ownership tests.
Added unit tests for shader stage disposal in GizmosRenderer, PlanetRenderer, MilkyWayRenderer and OceanRenderer.

commits.author: aaron.koolen-bourke
lines: Fixed the debug RenderTechnique in Planet.Render.Debug not disposing its shader stages.
Added a behavioral unit test for debug RenderTechnique disposal.
Removed the source-text tests for GizmosRenderer, PlanetRenderer, MilkyWayRenderer and OceanRenderer because those renderers can't be constructed in a test.

commits.author: aaron.koolen-bourke
lines: Fixed MeshAsset leaking its native buffers when glTF mesh loading throws an exception.
Added a native collection leak review document and updated the ownership tracking board.

commits.author: aaron.koolen-bourke

Updated the glTF animation channel path checks for the new Brutal.Gltf API.
Fixed RenderTechnique.CreateShaderStages creating shader stages that destroy shared shader modules when they are disposed.
Added a unit test that checks shared shader modules stay alive after a RenderTechnique rebuilds its pipeline and is disposed.

commits.author: aaron.koolen-bourke

lines: Fixed tanks on a part's sub-parts never supplying its habitat.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz

The EVA suit is now a habitat on the kitten's back with 8 hours of oxygen and CO₂ cartridge, a 1 L drink bag and one meal.
It's filled from the vessel the kitten leaves and whatever is left goes back into the vessel it boards. In breathable air the suit takes and uses only water and food.
Boarding warns when the vessel has no room for what's left in the suit and throws away what won't fit.
The backpack's part window shows the suit's life support like any other habitat.
The EVA suit line on the crew portrait shows the suit's time left or "Breathing External Air". Its tooltip lists the suit's oxygen, CO₂ cartridge, water and food time.
The habitat part window lists each kitten's condition including what it's going without.

Press G within 2 m of a habitat with storage to open the Supplies window and take or stow supplies. EVA Kittens cannot eat or use what they carry.
Carried supplies add to the kitten's mass so the jetpack works harder when loaded.
Supplies a kitten is carrying go aboard when the kitten boards. The Board prompt warns about any meals or CO₂ canisters there is no room for, which are thrown away.
The EVA suit tooltip on the crew portrait shows what the kitten is carrying.

Added a unit test for the kitten's condition poses in the shipped content.

commits.author: lghassen
lines: Add a small prefiltered sky reflection LUT prefiltered for GGX roughness, this makes reflections on rough surfaces more accurate and less buggy, and fixes a "glow" like effect due to lerping the old reflections with the ambient to fake intermediate roughness levels in reflections

Plume trail performance optimizations and fixes for large numbers of trail segments and some edge cases: Change the method used for the first stage of coarse segment culling to a more appropriate one, this helps performance when rendering more than 10k trail segments. Fix issue where some plume segments can survive past their lifetime, while being invisible, and continue being carried by wind and splitting into smaller segments, causing a big performance hit. This addresses two big bottlenecks, some bottlenecks remain in the volume cache building and the plume shadow cascades which still need to be addressed for better performance at scale.
Add additional criteria for plume trail LOD selection and segment splitting, based on when the plume radius can hide small changes in direction.
Fix issue where some plume segments can survive past their lifetime, while being invisible, and continue being carried by wind and splitting into smaller segments, causing a big performance hit

Increase the max size of the lists holding per-voxel segments when the existing cap is reached, this fixes an issues where in some cases in very dense plumes, parts of the plumes can disappear when the moving the camera
Make plume trail sections that drift with wind dissolve a bit faster
Add additional detail in GPU and CPU profiler tags for the plume trails

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Updated aerodynamic meshing to take into account thin plates (shapes thin in only one dimension). If a volume is completely enclosed within thin shapes, that area now becomes an aerodynamic solid. If there is an unclosed area of plates large enough to be aerodynamically relevant, they become freestanding zero-depth aerodynamic walls or fins.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Added a full gas mixture and temperature-by-altitude profile for all atmospheres. This is a necessary step to obtain the ratio of specific heats, gamma, which directly affects gas properties for aerodynamics. This has rebalanced atmospheric heights for all bodies, sometimes drastically. Earth's atmosphere now extends just beyond 173 km.
Split the physical atmosphere XML data class from the runtime class, since it now builds several data products after load, similar to other substance records.
Added atmospheric mixtures to the thermo toolkit.
Extended thermal reaction temperature ranges well into ionization levels so that the dev fusion drive no longer requires separate physics.
Regenerated all thermo toolkit files. This resulted in some changes to game data which had been hand-spliced in.
Added sulfur dioxide to the list of volatiles in the game.
